items.label: Capture the current tracked Markdown inventory and risk shape before cleanup.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control, Core, Backend, and Editor tracked Markdown counts and high-risk clusters are identified before any deletion.
items.verificationNote: Read-only audit found Project Control 91 tracked Markdown files, Core 352, Backend 40, and Editor 59, with high-risk roadmap/status clusters in Core, Editor, and Backend. No product-repository Markdown was edited or deleted in this phase.

items.label: Define Project Control as the canonical home for FlowDoc-wide shared understanding.
items.evidenceTarget: The policy states where FlowDoc-wide documentation authority lives and what repo-local Markdown must not claim.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-documentation-authority-policy.md states that Project Control is the canonical home for FlowDoc-wide shared understanding, while product repositories keep local implementation and test ownership.

items.label: Separate allowed repo-local Markdown from duplicate shared truth.
items.evidenceTarget: The policy allows only code-adjacent, repository-owned, or historical repo-local Markdown and requires Authority Boundary wording for survivors.
items.verificationNote: The policy allows repository entrypoints, setup/package/example guidance, code-adjacent contracts, implementation notes, and historical source docs; surviving repo-local Markdown must declare an Authority Boundary.

items.label: Define cleanup sequencing before deletion.
items.evidenceTarget: The policy blocks deletion until inventory, classification, summary or registration, and retirement decisions are complete.
items.verificationNote: The policy orders cleanup as Inventory -> classify -> summarize or register -> retire and states that repo-local Markdown is not deleted by this foundation phase.

items.label: Guard future agents without prematurely rewriting role definitions.
items.evidenceTarget: Agent-facing Project Control guidance points future rooms to the documentation authority policy while deferring role revisions until cleanup evidence exists.
items.verificationNote: AGENTS.md, the copy-ready global guidance, and the agent operating model now point to the documentation authority policy. The policy explicitly leaves role revisions for after cleanup evidence is recorded.

items.label: Verify Project Control records and generated read model.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control data validation and focused documentation authority tests pass before the policy foundation is treated as recorded.
items.verificationNote: Focused verification target is npm run check:data plus npx vitest run tests/documentation-authority-policy.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 after data and documentation records are added.
